/* Configuración general del scroll por secciones */
html, body {
  height: 100vh;

.section.level1 {
  min-height: 100vh;
  width: 100%;
  scroll-snap-align: start;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 40px 60px;
  display: flex;

  text-align: center;

/* Subsecciones (nivel 2) con flujo normal para que no se encimen */

}

/* Ajuste específico para bloques de código y consola de R */

# Registros de presencia 

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

gbif <- read.csv("D:/2026_ENM/Centralidad/A_mon.csv")
head(gbif)

```

# Variables 

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

library(terra)

setwd("D:/2026_ENM/Centralidad/vars")
vars <- list.files(pattern = ".tif")
vars <- rast(vars)
plot(vars)

```

# Formato

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

library(terra)

data <- extract(vars, gbif[, c(1:2)], df = TRUE)
data <- cbind(gbif, data[c(-1)])
head(data)

```

## Hipótesis M

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

library(terra)

jjm <- vect("D:/2026_ENM/Calibracion/ecoreg/Ecoregions2017.shp")
occ1 <- gbif
occ2 <- vect(as.matrix(occ1), type = "points", crs = "EPSG:4326")
jjm_subset <- jjm[occ2, ] 
ecor <- aggregate(jjm_subset)
ecor_M <- crop(vars, ecor, mask = TRUE)
plot(ecor_M[[1]])
plot(ecor, add = TRUE, border = "blue", lwd = 2)
points(occ1, pch = 3)

```

## Construir elipsoides

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

#devtools::install_github("luismurao/ntbox")
library(ntbox)
library(raster)
library(rgl)
#library(devtools)
#install_github("cran/rglwidget")
library(rglwidget)

ecor_M <- raster::stack(ecor_M)
covar_centroid <- cov_center(data, mve = TRUE, level = 0.95, vars = c(3:5))
ellipsoidMod <- ellipsoidfit(ecor_M[[1:3]], covar_centroid$centroid, covar_centroid$covariance, level = 0.95, plot = FALSE, size = 1, alpha = 0.2)

```

# Visualizar el modelo

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

plot(ellipsoidMod$suitRaster)
points(data[, c(1:2)])

```

# Visualizar el ellipsoide

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}

library(raster)
library(rgl)
#library(devtools)
#install_github("cran/rglwidget")
library(rglwidget)

ecor_M <- raster::stack(ecor_M)
covar_centroid <- cov_center(data, mve = TRUE, level = 0.95, vars = c(3:5))
ellipsoidMod <- ellipsoidfit(ecor_M[[1:3]], covar_centroid$centroid, covar_centroid$covariance, level = 0.95, plot = FALSE, size = 1, alpha = 0.2)


ellipsoid_95 <- ellipse3d(covar_centroid$covariance, centre = covar_centroid$centroid, level = 0.95)
rgl::wire3d(ellipsoid_95, col = "red", add = TRUE)
rgl::points3d(data[, c(3:5)], size = 5, col = "red", add = TRUE)
box3d(col = "black")
rglwidget::rglwidget()

```

# Extraer información del modelo

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

ab_data <- raster::extract(ellipsoidMod$suitRaster, df_merge[, c(6:5)])

cor_data <- cbind(df_merge[, 4], ab_data)
cor_data <- na.omit(cor_data)
colnames(cor_data) <- c("abun", "DNC")
cor_data <- as.data.frame(cor_data)
cor_data$DNC <- 1-cor_data$DNC
head(cor_data)

```

# Visualizamos

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(dismo)

formula <- y ~ poly(x, 2, raw = TRUE)

ggplot(cor_data, aes(DNC, abun)) +
  geom_point(shape = 1, size = 1, color = "black") +
  stat_cor(method = "spearman", cor.coef.name = "rho", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top") +
  labs(x = "DNC", y = "Abundance") +
  geom_smooth(color = "red", method = "lm", formula = formula, se = TRUE) +
  stat_regline_equation(aes(label =  paste(after_stat(eq.label), sep = "~~~~")), formula = formula, label.y = 450) +
  theme_bw()

```

# Inferencias sobre los registros

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(dismo)

inf_vals <- raster::extract(ellipsoidMod$suitRaster, data[, c(1:2)])
if (is.matrix(inf_vals) || is.data.frame(inf_vals)) {
  inf_vals <- inf_vals[, ncol(inf_vals)]
}
inf_dnc <- 1 - inf_vals

formula_lm <- abun ~ poly(DNC, 2, raw = TRUE)
ajuste <- lm(formula_lm, data = cor_data)
abun_esperada <- predict(ajuste, newdata = data.frame(DNC = inf_dnc))

df_esperados <- data.frame(DNC = inf_dnc, abun = abun_esperada)

ggplot(cor_data, aes(DNC, abun)) +
  geom_point(shape = 1, size = 1.5, color = "black") +
  stat_cor(method = "spearman", cor.coef.name = "rho", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top") +
  labs(x = "DNC", y = "Abundance") +
  geom_smooth(color = "red", method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x, 2, raw = TRUE), se = TRUE) +
  geom_point(data = df_esperados, aes(DNC, abun), shape = 4, size = 2, color = "blue", stroke = 1) +
  stat_regline_equation(aes(label = paste(after_stat(eq.label), sep = "~~~~")), formula = y ~ poly(x, 2, raw = TRUE), label.y = 450) +
  theme_bw()

```

# Inferencias sobre la geografía

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}

library(terra)

dnc_raster <- 1 - ellipsoidMod$suitRaster
coefs <- coef(ajuste)

abund_raster <- coefs[1] + coefs[2] * dnc_raster + coefs[3] * (dnc_raster^2)

plot(rast(abund_raster), main = "Abundance")

```
